Outstanding Service with a Fusion of Flavors!
Oct 2025 • Family
About ten years ago, we used to dine at this restaurant 1-2 times a week since we lived nearby. It was one of our favorite spots in Hanoi. When we returned after a decade, we were delighted to find that it’s even better than before!

Mr. Masuda, the owner, is an exceptional chef and a wonderful host. His cuisine is innovative, blending various culinary traditions with finesse - each dish is delicately and beautifully presented. The staff are highly trained, speaking Vietnamese, English, and some Japanese, which enhances the dining experience.

This restaurant is a shining example of how a passionate owner’s dedication to his customers, his craft, and his team can lead to lasting success. Well done, Masuda-san!

Dinner with a friend
Jan 2024 • Friends
My husband and I met a friend for dinner. Pépé had good reviews, so we decided to try it, even though the mix of food offerings was a bit odd. We ordered the pork and crab dumplings and the regular dumplings. Both were solid choices. We also ordered the fried mozzarella, which was delicious. Main dishes were good but nothing amazing. My husband had the carbonara, and I had the clam linguini. Our friend ordered mushroom pasta and didn’t seem too impressed; she sent it back half eaten. After the main, the servers never came back to offer additional drinks or dessert. That part of service was odd. For the three of us with one drink each, the total was 1.5 mil VND.

Amazing food and service
Nov 2023 • Family
We stumbled upon this restaurant our last day in Hanoi. Had a light lunch there and was struck by the authentic taste, and therefore came back for dinner. The menu has a mixture of Japanese, Chinese and European food. We ordered mostly European food, 7 plates in all, and they were all delicious and very well prepared. They were brought out one dish at a time, with plates changed after each dish, so it seemed like we had a 7 course dinner! They have two home-made pasta dish which are both amazing. The price was also right. This is in contrast to the night before when we had a so-called expensive Italian dinner at an upscale hotel nearby which turned out to be made believe mediocre fare.

An easy 5 stars!
Apr 2022 • Solo
Visited Pepe la Poule for dinner on my last night in Hanoi. I immediately regretted not visiting more!

Really delicious food. I was initially a bit wary of the quite large menu (I always am when a resto looks like they are offering loads of different dishes) but I needn't have been. Delicious!

The view across the bay is really spectacular - I reccomend you ask to be seated on the top floor.

NB: I reckon that this place is definitely would be among the top ten in Hanoi on TripAdvisor, were it not for the fact that many other restos ahead of it often have a very large number of 5* reviews posted by accounts who have only made 1 contribution on TripAdvisor. Hmmm.
